notes.title: Update Notes For September 11 2025
notes.content:
[b]Endless Side Mission Bug[/b] – Resolved an issue where side mission requests could continue indefinitely.
[b]Sector 2 Balance Pass[/b] – Adjusted difficulty to create a smoother, more strategic experience.
[b]Enemy Deck Updates[/b] – Various enemy cards and decks have been rebalanced with a mix of buffs and nerfs.

notes.title: Update Notes 8 September 2025
notes.content:
[b]1. Side Missions[/b]

Fixed the side mission appearance bug. You should now have a new side mission waiting for you after each card battle (win/lose).
 
[b]2. Enemy Sector 1 – Balance Update[/b]

[list]
[*] Adjusted enemy card HP, AP, and abilities for better game balance.
[*] Reworked overall deck compositions to provide a more challenging and fair experience.
[/list]

[b]3. Enemy Abilities – New Additions[/b]
[i]Enemies are now more dynamic and unpredictable with new combat mechanics:[/i]

[list]
[*] Special Casts: Enemies can trigger special abilities on taking damage, confirming a kill, or upon death.
[*] Retaliation: Certain enemies can strike back when attacked.
[*] Armor Piercing: Bypasses shield defenses.
[*] Drain: Steals health or AP from the player.
[*] Random Discard: Forces the player to discard a random item card.
[/list]

[b]4. Localization Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] French added.
[*] German added.
[*] Italian added.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes 4 September 2025
notes.content:
Shield Cap – Shields are now capped at 80% for better balance.
Safeguard Card Buff – Now provides a +30% shield.
Vera Ability Adjustment – Changed from 1 AP for 3 cards to 2 AP for 2 cards for improved balance.

notes.title: Update Notes for September 02 2025
notes.content: Resolved a performance problem leading to GPU spikes in Buff Mode. Buff Mode now runs smoother.

notes.title: Noir Lords – First Major Update
notes.content: [p][b]New Features[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Hospital System[/b] – Victory cards now die and go to the hospital; defeat sends all cards to the hospital.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sabotage 90[/b] – A completely new mode where you play a short card game to sabotage the strongest card in the upcoming match. You can also play Sabotage 90 to earn resources. But beware, losing comes with its own consequences.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Buff Mode[/b] – Added to normal gameplay. You can now buff selected cards’ health, attack points, and turn points (Only buff cards can do this).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Intro Story[/b] – The story has been added, and you can rewatch it even if you have already made progress.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Gameplay & Balance[/b][/p][list][*][p]Stage 1 nerfed; overall levels rebalanced for smoother progression.[/p][/*][*][p]Match deck building added — you can now build a deck of up to 5 cards.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved random deck completion method for more strategic gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Pack results rebalanced for fairer and more consistent gameplay.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Quality of Life[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Inventory Overhaul[/b] – Inventory limit set to 35. The prerequisite page has been removed; inventory now opens directly, and everything is managed inside a single page.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reset Button[/b] – Added option to fully reset your progress.[/p][/*][*][p]Mini animation improvements: smoother blends and faster pacing.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor UI fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]Wording and text adjustments for clarity.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45612124/88fe1f00490ff182408a08bf9eb329525b9ce96d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update Notes For 13/08/2025
notes.content:
Reduced warning text animation speed for smoother readability.

Fixed a misconception where the intro appeared to grant extra +10K credits.

The tutorial no longer incorrectly displays credits as a reward after victory.

Enemy turn points are now visible on the HUD.

When a card is used and becomes unavailable for the rest of the round, it now shows as Exhausted.

Adjusted side mission flow. You’ll warm up with easier missions before tackling longer or harder ones.

Updated blocking skill explanation and warnings for better clarity.

Starter pack composition adjusted to better fit new player needs.

Card usage section now shows remaining uses when hovering over a card.

Fixed an error that caused a null inventory when exiting with the ESC key.

notes.title: 3rd Update: Hotfix 003
notes.content:
This hotfix focuses on cleaning up the tutorial experience:

Duplicate card bug squashed – Losing in the tutorial used to sneak an extra copy of a card into your deck when you restarted. Now your deck stays exactly as it should. No more uninvited guests.

Language selection streamlined – Previously, the language page popped up every time you opened the tutorial. Now it asks just once and remembers your choice.

notes.title: 2nd Update: Hotfix 002
notes.content:
Thanks so much for the quick feedback, everyone! You’ve been amazing! ❤️
Here’s what’s changed based on what you asked for:

Language Page Clarity – It was a bit tricky to tell if you’d actually selected a language. That’s now much clearer, so no more second-guessing.

Side Mission Balance – They were a bit too overpowered, so I have given them a small nerf to keep things fair.

Card Selection Bug Fix – There was a pesky bug where you could re-select a card you’d already used, causing the selection to lock until you ended your turn. That’s all fixed now, so card play should feel much smoother.

notes.title: 1st Update: Hotfix 001
notes.content:
Here is the first update for Noir Lords, where some small errors and bugs were caught thanks to you!

What’s New:

Chinese Localization: Previously, the Chinese translation wasn’t working. Now it’s fully functional.

Pack Page Bug Fix: Fixed an issue where packs could be accidentally opened during the page’s closing animation.

Side Mission Inventory Limit: Sending an agent to a side mission could let you exceed the inventory limit. This has been fixed.

notes.title: 📢 Noir Lords Release Date Update – Launching August 8
notes.content: [p]Detectives and strategists,[/p][p]We’re making a small but meaningful shift to the release date of [i]Noir Lords[/i]. The game will now officially launch on [b]August 8[/b] (2 extra weeks) to ensure everything plays smoothly and the campaign lands exactly as planned.[/p][p]This final stretch is all about [b]polish and precision[/b]. Tightening up the experience so your dive into Noir City is as sharp and immersive as it should be.  Thank you for your patience and support. The wait’s almost over.[/p][p][b]Wishlist [i]Noir Lords[/i][/b] now and be ready when the city calls.[/p]
